description:
OPT and EAD can apply 
 

 Expert level experience in custom development of eCommerce application using Oracle ATG with Commerce and Personalization capabilities. 
 Expert level experience in customizing ATG Commerce and Merchandizing modules including customizing Catalog, Product display, Pricing, Coupon, Promotions, Cart, Checkout, fulfillment and inventory management. 
 Expert level experience with ATG Personalization using targeters, segments and scenarios. 
 Expert level experience with programatic catalog loading, Catalog customization, BCC customization, creating deployment agents, configuring source and destination repositories. 
 Proficient using BCC, and dyn-admin. 
 Expert level experience in maintaining and troubleshooting production environment of multi-clustered Oracle Commerce Setup on Weblogic and Oracle DB. 
 Expert level experience with SOAP and Rest Webservices. 
 

 DESIRED SKILLS: 
 Experience in Agile methodology of development 
 Experience in custom development of Oracle Endeca on ATG Commerce. 
 Experience in ITIL, MDEX, Application layer development and utilizing Assemblers. 
 Experience in consuming ATG Catalog from Endeca. 
 Experience in creating/integrating and utilizing records, queries, dimensions, dimension hierarchies and properties. 
 Experience in customizing guided navigation capabilities to suit business needs. 
 Experience in custom development of templates and Cartridges 
 Proficiency using Workbench and Experience Manager.

 Android Developer OpenGL

 Multiple Openings
